highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 refreshes the bundled Skia renderer and makes package API documentation more accessible.
highlights_body: NuGet packages now carry compiler-generated XML documentation, while the binding and documentation tooling have been modernized for more consistent API reference content.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer with upstream Chrome m154 fixes, including a buffer-upload correction.
NuGet packages now include compiler-generated XML documentation, with API comments and Markdown-capable remarks supplying richer reference content in supported IDEs.

contributor_summaries.azchohfi: Improved the bundled HarfBuzz build by narrowly scoping compiler-warning suppressions
